suggested_snapshot_fields_to_add.why: Lets the planner deterministically target the engine-predicted post-move hex of fast movers.
Shows which hex an attack is actually checked against after timing, avoiding wrong current-cell targeting.
Provides a direct numeric score for attacks that hit an enemy’s predicted landing cell/path this turn.
Lets the planner directly detect when an option damages a move-before-attack enemy on its predicted landing cell/path, removing guesswork from timing interactions.
Shows exactly which predicted enemy cells/paths are covered by each option, enabling deterministic landing-cell targeting and focus fire.
Identifies the enemy most directly affected after predicted movement, simplifying consistent concentration on the same target.
